## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e9d9631e1b8606452c0ac1fadc3eece97ecb5019`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + none

Inputs read: card 32518 (body and its three comments: triage 6813025698, claim 6813316669, dev report 6813721410), the PR body and file list, the net diff against `main` (2 files, +2 −2), and the check-runs on the head. Read to judge, not reviewed: `lanes/triage.md`, `seat-lifecycle.md`, `lanes/director.md`, `SKILL.md` L81, the `--release` header of `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`, the ruling comment 6595514258 on card 29775, and the patches of PRs 25422, 27266 and 31635.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set and public surface: none moves. Two lines of internal rules text; no schema, no package, no script, no gate. Right.
- Gate verdicts are the head's check-runs: all 23 non-skipped runs completed `success`, among them `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards` and `Check Changeset`. No run failed, none is pending.
- Ratchet, read off the tree: `dispatch-runbook.md` 245 lines on `main` and on the head against ceiling 245; `triage-duties.md` 101 and 101 against ceiling 101. Edited bullets are 116 bytes (was 114) and 120 bytes (was 120), both within 120. Payment is in the same line of the same file both times; no line cut, no re-wrap, no ceiling touched, no issue number in either line. Right.
- The two literals `label-write.mjs --self-test` pins against `triage-duties.md` (`RECLAIM_AFTER_HOURS = 12` on L84, the `Owned-24h re-check:` key on L83) are still spelled. No script or workflow quotes the reworded phrases (「在飞活性复查」, 「敲门一次」, 「沿用 SKILL.md」, 「简报只指不拷」). Right.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: nothing under a published package moves. `Clause-②: no` holds: no accept-set narrows or widens, and `Metadata-protocol: none` matches a diff with no metadata key in it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty; `deviations`: none to the order. Nothing to answer.
- Out-of-scope note 1 (the `label-write.mjs` `--release` header says "triage posts the owned-24h re-check" and "triage re-knocks", and its release fixture is signed by a triage seat): confirmed on `main` L101 and L111. The tool carries no actor check, so the stroke is the same whoever sends it, and header prose is not a declared contract (`triage-duties.md` L52). Carried in the PR's `## Acceptance notes`, which is where it belongs. Answered; see nit 3.
- Out-of-scope note 2 (the director seat runs no patrol, so no schedule runs the 12 h clock): confirmed in `lanes/director.md` L7 and L17. It predates this PR (the attribution dates from PR 25422) and the diff neither creates nor widens it. An issue-comment search for the knock key returns only this card, two closed tooling cards and one seat post, none of them a knock on a work card. Answered as an observation; not escalated by this record, since no act in the diff depends on it.

### ④ Design judgment

**`dispatch-runbook.md` L53.** The old pointer was wrong on `main`: `SKILL.md` has no round-report section; its stage index (L81) lists 「轮次报告与节奏」 under `references/seat-lifecycle.md`, and that heading is at `seat-lifecycle.md` L64, with the health indicators the brief's third segment copies at L73–77 and the definition of M at L74. The new pointer resolves. The payment drops 「简报」 from 「简报只指不拷」; the bullet's subject is still the brief's index table and segments, so the rule "details are not restated, point and do not copy" is whole. 「沿用」 to 「照」 keeps the sense. No rule lost.

**`triage-duties.md` L83.** Which seat performs which release today, read on `main`:
- Triage: none. `lanes/triage.md` L17–19 gives triage the `Request: progress` knock, the two-silences-is-down reading and the hand to a sibling seat, and ends 「⛔ 分诊永不释放」. That is the ruling on card 29775 (comment 6595514258, letter A, the maintainer's 「同意29775 A」): "⛔ Triage does not release claims".
- Director seat: the silent-claim reclaim. `seat-lifecycle.md` L33–34 puts liveness in the director digest and says the release after `RECLAIM_AFTER_HOURS` is 「由总监席一笔中继释放,细则 `triage-duties.md`」.
- The holder and the lane seats: their own `Release:` (`state-machine.md` L41), sign-off hand-back (`seat-lifecycle.md` L37), partial landing (`execution-duties.md` L71), a cloud-involved card (`cross-repo-coordination.md` L47). None is in the diff.

The dev's history holds against the patches: PR 25422 added to `triage-duties.md` 「活性复查同归[总监席摘要],细则留本文」 and to `lanes/director.md` 「座位贴与在飞活性复查归本摘要」; PR 27266 removed the first; PR 31635 removed the second. So `triage-duties.md` L83–85 has been the director's detail since 25422 and lost its actor by two cuts. Naming 「总监席」 on L83 restores an attribution two other files already state; it moves no act between seats. 「敲门一次」 to 「敲一次」 is still one knock, and L84 「敲门后」 still reads back to it. I tried to break it three ways and none lands: (a) the tool refuses a triage sender after this change — it does not, it has no actor check; (b) a second file still gives triage the release — a grep of 「释放」 and `Release:` across the skill and `AGENTS.md` finds none; (c) the edit takes the knock away from a seat that performs it — the knock named here is the `Owned-24h re-check:`, not triage's `Request: progress`, which is untouched in `lanes/triage.md` and `project-forms.md`.

Findings:
1. **nit** — `triage-duties.md` L82 still lists 「下三行」 as an exception to a don't-touch rule whose reader is triage (L3), and L84–85 name no actor of their own. With L83 now leading 「总监席」 the three lines read as the director's, and `lanes/triage.md` L19 plus `seat-lifecycle.md` L34 close the question, so no seat is misled into an act. Both files sit at headroom 0; left as an accepted deviation.
2. **nit** — the pointer says 「轮次报告节」, the heading is 「轮次报告与节奏」. It is the only section of that name in the file, so it resolves. The brief's fourth segment (接力清单) is not defined in that section either; that is the same on `main` and outside this diff.
3. **nit** (outside the diff, read not reviewed) — `label-write.mjs`'s header and fixture still name triage as the knocker. Carried in the PR's acceptance notes; fixing it here would move the head.

No must-fix, no should-fix. The wording changes WHO may do WHAT nowhere.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-32518-rules-pointer-and-triage-release`
Reviewed-by: `fable subagent of session_01Utp6CaqHXh17Qc3C7MRAQw`

**VERDICT: PASS**
